name: Transformer cooler supply-loss input
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Reports loss of the monitored electrical supply to the transformer cooling system.
description: Reports loss of the monitored electrical supply to the transformer cooling system. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Cooling supply supervision” at the input and “Cooling supply-loss alarm” at the output. A supply alarm differs from a temperature alarm.
